author: retrobyte
quote: After more than a decade of waiting, this is a MASSIVE letdown. As someone who has played every GTA since childhood, I barely recognize the franchise here. The edge is completely gone replaced by heavy restrictions, a sanitized world, and one-sided modern politics that feel completely out of place in a series built on satire. Don’t waste your money on this. Go back and play GTA IV if you want real substance, complex characters, and an actual story. If you want to spend 25 hours playing a glorified girlfriend-pleasing, simp simulator, though, GTA VI is made for you. Enjoy
